description: This file defines an abstract class `ChatService` that provides an interface for sending chat messages, either via a real API (such as OpenAI) or a mocked implementation, used within a Flutter application.

classes.name: ChatService
classes.description: An abstract class that declares a method for sending chat messages, intended to be implemented by different concrete classes depending on the scenario (real API or mock).

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: An abstract method that takes a list of `ChatMessage` objects and returns a Future resolving to a String containing the assistant's response content.
